newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: PT ABN AMRO launches Indonesian funds.
newsitem.headline: PT ABN AMRO launches Indonesian funds.

text.p: PT ABN AMRO Manajemen Investasi, a unit of Dutch ABN AMRO Bank N.V., said on Tuesday in a statement that it obtained approval to launch Indonesian mutual funds.
The funds include Indonesia Equity Fund, Indonesia Bond Fund, Indonesia Rupiah Money Market Fund, and Indonesia U.S. Dollar Money Market Fund.
The funds, which will invest locally, can be sold globally.
ABN AMRO Bank is the first foreign banking group to obtain a license to launch Indonesian open-ended mutual funds.
The Indonesian subsidiary will be setting up a series of shareshops throughout Indonesia to market these funds, with the most recent one established today in Denpasar, Bali.
